example/repo

A fixture page exercising the GitHub host selector path. This HTML is intentionally minimal — the screenshot E2E test only needs the DOM shape to be representative, not the production CSS / JS bundle.

Installation

npm install example-repo

Usage

Import and call. The selector test asserts that the article.markdown-body selector matches exactly this element, not the sibling sidebar or the AppHeader nav.

const repo = require('example-repo');
repo.run();

Why a fixture?

See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-20-screenshot-e2e-snapshot-tests.md for the design. Five consecutive releases (v1.4.17 - v1.5.6) fixed a screenshot framing regression. This fixture is the regression net.
